name: Midascore
_notes: Transcribed from sheet DU2394 (Lv I-IX), trait card DX3222 (Incremental Painment), Amongst the Bleached Bones trait card, AI DR2395-DR2414, BP DS2416-DS2433, Impaled status DR2415.
Lv III/IV right box (+3 / +12 jar icon) is a campaign value — ignored. Hand icon on AI cards = number of Midas tokens.
Covetous / Greed-crazed / Enriched / Float condition cards and Irem Tower/City tile stats not scanned — placeholders.

traits.Goldtaste: Argonauts with the Goldthirst Curse Affliction must apply all FATE X+ or MIDAS X+ effects regardless of their actual FATE and Midas tokens.
traits.Shadow in the Skies: The Midascore ignores Line of Sight. During movement it does not destroy Terrain tiles, unless stated otherwise.
traits.Imperial Impetus: The Midascore moves 8 spaces forward in a straight line (Lv2: 9, Lv3: 10, Lv4+: 11). If it moves through or ends its move on a knocked down Titan, that Titan draws an Obol. When a Titan suffers Crash as a result of Imperial Impetus, they additionally gain 1 Midas token.
traits.Incremental Painment: Each time the Midascore gains a Wound (a Double Wound is 2 Wounds), place a Midas token on this card. Each time a Titan discards Midas tokens, place them here. After resolving the current action, if there are 5 or more Midas tokens on this card, discard 5 of them and perform Signature.
traits.Amongst the Bleached Bones: Normal (not Terrain) Battle Board spaces are considered Terrain tiles with the Chasm keyword.
traits.Cities of Gold: When a Terrain tile is displaced as a result of the Midascore's movement, place a generic token on that tile. If a Titan starts or ends their turn on a Terrain tile, they gain 1 Midas token for each generic token on that tile.
traits.Sunken Costs: End of Primordial Round: Gain DANGER equal to the number of Midas tokens you have.
traits.Unholy Inflation: When you are about to suffer Knockdown, if you have 3+ Midas tokens, suffer Float instead. When you are about to suffer Float, if you have the Windblight Curse Affliction, you die instead.
traits.Weight of Greed: When a Titan with Midas tokens dies, place half of their Midas tokens (rounding up) on the Incremental Painment Trait.
traits.End of Hope: End of Primordial Round: Perform Signature.
traits.Aggressive Expansion: At the start of the Primordial Round, perform ⚡ Airburst 3.
traits.Loss of Liquidity: Each Midas token on a non-Weapon Gear lowers your Speed and Hermes Move by 1. If you don't move during your Titan turn, you die.
traits.Soundspeed Impetus: If the Midascore moves through or ends its move on a knocked down or floating Titan, that Titan dies.
traits.Beginning of the End: End of Primordial Round: Before End of Hope, draw and perform another AI card.
traits.Debts of Succession: Double all Midas gain. When a Titan dies, after placing half of their Midas tokens on Incremental Painment, distribute the rest of the tokens evenly among all other Titans.
traits.Ruthless: Remove all positive Trauma cards from the Trauma decks (except Obols).
traits.Refuse Credit: Disable the Shifting keyword on Terrain tiles. The Midascore destroys Irem Towers during movement.

vp.text: Climb: Fury 9+ (Lv5+: 10+). Hold On — End of Primordial Round: if on the VP, test Endurance (9+; Lv5+: 10+). Fail: Knockdown, displace onto the closest Irem Tower. VP effects: +2 Power. Ignore normal Primordial responses; instead WOUND: Midas 1 (Lv5+: 3), ⚡ Imperial Impetus. FAIL: Airburst 2 (Lv5+: 4), ⚡ immediately perform the Hold On test.

impaled: If you become Impaled, place your miniature on this card. During your turn you can either try to Get Free or attack. You can only use Melee Weapons. WOUND: If you deal a Wound, in addition to normal responses, create a VP (you stay Impaled!). Get Free!: (combat action) Test Endurance or Fury (9+). If you succeed, displace 1. End of your turn: If you started your turn Impaled, Midas 2, then gain X+5 DANGER, where X is the number of Midas tokens you have, then resolve a Trauma Draw.
